:::{#def-logical-connective}
#### Logical connective

A **logical connective**
[@wikipedia_logical_connective]
builds a new proposition (@def-proposition)
from one or two propositions $P$ and $Q$,
with a truth value that depends only on the truth values of $P$ and $Q$.
These notes use five, defined next:
not (@def-not), and (@def-and), or (@def-or),
implies (@def-implies), and if and only if (@def-iff).

:::
